Allow The Ship To Leave: If you just won a battle at a Death Star site (or initiated a Force drain here), place a card stacked here in owner's Lost Pile. That Old Man Did It!: If you occupy this site and another Death Star site while no cards stacked here, for remainder of game, power 'shut down.'

|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 3) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card. It is the current version. Each version below is a published PC printing; card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository. Every visibly different printing is a separate version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026); a later copy of the same image in another format is not (13 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' compared with the previous version (the high-resolution image of 1 December 2023; left = before, right = after): [[File:V15-L-apowerloss_ai-2024-12-30-vs-hires-2023-12-01-changes.png|frameless|upright=2]].
* '''Original''' ([[A Power Loss (ALT)]]): PC high-resolution card image uploaded 26 August 2022<ref name="img-altpng-3ed4308-apowerlossaipng">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/apowerloss_ai.png</code> (high-resolution image) in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3ed4308531b909a81d213db4d364fab8c38685fc commit 3ed4308] (26 August 2022) (“GEMP Series 4 AIs, fixes”). The earliest published image of this card: it was only ever committed as a high-resolution PNG, so version lists built from the card-size images missed it (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; label “(AI)”; bottom margin “Out Of Commission”. Text: “Deploy on Central Core. Leia may not modify Force drains.
